use_case_summary: Workload types: product Q&A on product pages (chat with embedded product context), catalog enrichment (auto attributes, tags, short descriptions), reranking for search results.
Latency/throughput targets: P50 < 150ms for widget server-to-server calls; tolerate longer streaming for longer answers. Peak burst handling up to ~400 rps for short windows.
Cost sensitivity: SMB budget. Wants recommendations for batching, caching and embeddings to reduce token costs.
Model preferences: preference for cost-efficient open models (quantized variants); willing to test Redwood-hosted curated models. Needs fallbacks for capacity constraints.
Routing/fallback: prefer hosted_api but wants automatic degrade to smaller model or cached responses in high load.
Security/compliance: SOC2 desirable; basic audit logs; admin SSO is a plus but not blocker for POC.
Integration notes: primary platform Shopify + CDN; plan to host widget server-side to avoid client-side token exposure.
